events.before: LedgerLoop will provide customers at least 30 days' advance notice before authorizing a new subprocessor.
events.after: LedgerLoop will notify customers of new subprocessors by updating the online subprocessor list.
events.interpretation: A contractual notice period became a monitoring obligation. The change matters where renewal, production data and ownership already intersect.

surface.summary: Enterprise retention can be disabled, but the setting must be verified per tenant.
The published subprocessor notice changed after the recorded approval.
The trust centre is not extractable and enterprise retention controls are not public.

evidence.title: Review request opened
evidence.excerpt: Request submitted after the team had begun using Nimbus for call coaching.

evidence.title: Ten seats purchased
evidence.excerpt: Corporate card charge predates procurement intake by 17 days.

evidence.title: First Nimbus login
evidence.excerpt: Eight users authenticated before the request entered review.

evidence.title: Live transcripts enabled
evidence.excerpt: Customer call transcripts were sent to the production Nimbus tenant.

evidence.title: Approval requested after launch
evidence.excerpt: We already bought ten seats. What does Security need so we can keep this moving?

evidence.title: Retention setting is tenant-specific
evidence.excerpt: Enterprise customers may disable service-improvement retention through an administrative setting.

evidence.title: Evaluation requested before access
evidence.excerpt: The request defines a 30-day evaluation and prohibits production data.

evidence.title: Synthetic dataset prepared
evidence.excerpt: Evaluation corpus contains invented calls and generated contact records only.

evidence.title: Lab access granted
evidence.excerpt: OAuth grant followed the documented boundary review.

evidence.title: CRM lab boundary
evidence.excerpt: Production connectors and copied customer records are prohibited in the evaluation tenant.

evidence.title: Decision framed with trade-offs
evidence.excerpt: We need a decision on whether the retention control is enough for a synthetic-only evaluation.

evidence.title: Renewal due
evidence.excerpt: Automatic renewal window closes in 21 days; contract owner remains Evan Brooks.

evidence.title: Contract owner departed
evidence.excerpt: Evan Brooks left Finance Systems; no successor was recorded for LedgerLoop.

evidence.title: Production integration
evidence.excerpt: LedgerLoop reads general-ledger entries and invoice metadata from NetSuite nightly.

evidence.title: NetSuite technical owner
evidence.excerpt: Sofia Laurent owns production integration changes for Finance Systems.

evidence.title: Notice term changed
evidence.excerpt: The published DPA replaced 30-day advance notice with notice through the online list.

evidence.title: Pilot request lacks intended use
evidence.excerpt: The request does not say whether calls, notes or support attachments will be uploaded.

evidence.title: Trust centre unreadable
evidence.excerpt: The client-rendered trust centre yielded no durable text for retention or enterprise controls.
